questions.prompt: Which command downloads providers and prepares a Terraform working directory?
questions.explanation: terraform init initializes the directory and downloads providers.

questions.prompt: Which command shows what Terraform will do without making any changes?
questions.explanation: terraform plan is the dry-run preview.

questions.prompt: In terraform plan output, what does the + symbol mean?
questions.explanation: + indicates a resource that will be created.

questions.prompt: Which file should generally NOT be committed to version control?
questions.explanation: terraform.tfstate contains sensitive state and should use a remote backend.

options: Removes all resources managed by the configuration
questions.answer: Removes all resources managed by the configuration
questions.explanation: terraform destroy tears down everything in the configuration.
